title: Dollar to Benefit From U.S., Europe Growth Differential, BNP Paribas Says
description: Apr.30 -- Daniel Morris, senior investment strategist at BNP Paribas Asset Management, discusses the U.S. economy, Fed policy and the dollar. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance."

asr.full_text: We know the president wants lower rates. Have you ever seen this polarity that we've got right now? Well, I think it's a reflection of, you know, the uncertainty I think we have about the current economic environment and what's happening when inflation, when you have growth as strong as it is. We're working on economic models over the last, you know, 50 hundred years, which tell us if you have unemployment below 4% and wages rising, you should also see inflation rising in the economy. THE FOLKS IN POLICY ARE REALLY SOMETHING WE ALREADY SEE IN EUROPE OF COURSE IN THE LAST 50, 100 YEARS, WHICH TELL US, IF YOU HAVE UNEMPLOYMENT BELOW 4% AND WAGE IS RISING YOU SHOULD ALSO SEE INFLATION RISING IN THE ECONOMY. WE ARE ABOVE TREND GROWTH. WE HAVE BEEN ABOVE TREND FOR QUITE A LONG TIME. IN CONTRAST, WE'RE ACTUALLY HAVING INFLATION FALLING, SO WE DON'T KNOW WHAT TO DO WITH THAT AND THERE'S A LOT OF DIFFERENT INTERPRETATIONS OF WHAT IT MEANS AND WHAT IMPLICATIONS ARE FOR POLICY. IS THIS A TECHNOLOGY OVERLAY? I MEAN TAKE PRODUCTIVITY, policy is this technology overlay take productivity capital labor labor in so on the rest there total factor analysis I mean is this just technology overlay in the system and we don't know what to do with it I'm kind think fundamentally that a big part of what's going on and if you think about an economy you know the scoring at three point two percent historically you would say you know if that type of growth rate we're just not going to have enough drivers are not going to have enough automobiles are going to have to much I THINK BECAUSE OF THAT, IT'S NOT THAT HIGH. A LITTLE MORE THAN .2%. HISTORICALLY YOU WOULD SAY THAT TYPE OF GROWTH RATE WE'RE NOT GOING TO HAVE ENOUGH DRIVERS. WE'RE NOT GOING TO HAVE ENOUGH AUTOMOBILES. WE'RE GOING TO HAVE TOO MUCH DEMAND LARGELY TIP TO THE CAPACITY OF THE ECONOMY TO SUPPLY THAT. SO PRICES ARE GOING TO GO UP. WHAT WE HAVE IS UBER AND SHARING APPS AND SO ON WERE ABLE TO UTILIZE THE ASSETS IN THE ECONOMY MUCH MORE EFFICIENTLY GET FURTHER GROWTH WITHOUT THE INCREASE IN INFLATION. IT'S THAT PARADIGM SHIFT WE'RE further growth without the increase in inflation. And I think it's that paradigm shift that we're undergoing right now and that we need to really think very deeply about. Dan where do you see dollar are going from here? And how does that you know how does it underpin actually your investment strategy. Well I think it's a very good point because you know what you see now on one hand in terms of monetary policy globally for the major central banks nothing is going to happen. Interest rates are flat. They may be going down. So you don't want to see much of an interest rate differential driving currency. So it's going to come down to growth. TO IMPLOY DOLLAR FOR OXYGEN SUPPLIES, THEY ARE RARE. WHEN YOU SEE RISK IN BANKS, NOTHING IS GOING TO HAPPEN. THE INTEREST RATES ARE FLAT. THEY MAY BE GOING DOWN. YOU ARE NOT GOING TO SEE MUCH OF INTEREST RATES DRIVING CURRENCIES SO IT WILL COME DOWN TO GROWTH. YOU KNOW, WHAT WE ARE SEEING THIS QUARTER, EUROPE, NO DON'T POINT WHO KNOWS HOW MUCH BUT THERE IS

The broadcast framing and on-screen identification support treating it as financial news or commentary rather than a solicitation or deceptive promotion.
